QuestInfo.name: Transforming Warrior
QuestInfo.1: Find the transforming warrior of the dragon race. Make a party with a #bKaiser who is at least Lv. 120#k.\r\n\r\n#r<<To clear this mission you must make a party with a player on the same screen as you.>>#k

yes.0: Today's mission is to find the transforming warrior of the Nova... Kaiser! How about #bpartying up with a Lv. 120 or higher Kaiser#k? I'll take that as mission complete!

1.0: Ooh, you found the warrior of the dragon race! Your membership in the party proves it all. I'll give you a gift!
